flags.summary: Ilse found Kestrel Company's first tally on the crossroads milestone (forty strokes).
Ilse found the second tally on an ash at Tser Pool (thirty-one, and J.F.'s apology).
Stanimir told Ilse one soldier came back alone and went to Vallaki.
Ilse met Jory Fenn, the company's deserter, on Vallaki's wall.
The party asked Jory who in the company is still alive.
Ilse forgave Jory Fenn for running (Phase 6: his drum at the castle gate).
Jory gave Ilse the captain's roll of Kestrel Company (Phase 6: Ilse calls it).
Ilse told the party about the fever that kept her from the march.
Corporal Vell's patrol met the party on the castle road at night.
Ilse got through to Vell (Persuasion): he counted off and fought held back.
Corporal Vell is destroyed and counted off (encounter kestrel_patrol or kestrel_patrol_reached).
Tamsin opened the back of the locket: 'For T., from S. Every morning, at the water.'
Henrik's black carriage told Tamsin whose coach he robbed.
Arrigal confirmed the carriage was sent out empty with the locket, for a thief to find.
What Tamsin did with the locket at the Pool of the White Sun: pool, ireena or kept (Phase 6 reads it).
Hedda felt the Morninglord's warmth for a breath when St. Andral's bones came home.
Davian told Hedda the Keepers' story of the raven and the sun.
Silvain read Aurel's shorthand in the margins of his last note.
Rictavio told Silvain about meeting Aurel.
Silvain found Aurel's note to them in a chained book at the Amber Temple.
